title: Apple restores Facebook’s ability to run internal apps on iOS devices
text: Apple restores Facebook’s ability to run internal apps on iOS devices Friday, 1 February 2019 ( 7 hours ago ) It was recently reported that Apple had blocked Facebook from running its internal (e.g. developer betas, pre-release versions) apps on iOS.
